content.text:
All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position:

**Critical**
- **LOL-CAP** (deviation): cap protects TrueLink only, and only for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11; our liability is unlimited. Made mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1M, added consequential-damages exclusion and Excluded Claims.
- **INDEMN** (deviation): TrueLink indemnifies only for its own breach — no IP-infringement, breach-of-law, data-breach or misconduct limbs, against a very broad Client indemnity in 12(a). Added the Vendor limbs.
- **IP** (deviation): no confirmation we own our borrower data or Support Services work product, and 8(d) lets TrueLink resell Credit Data. Added ownership/licence-back and no-joint-ownership language.

**High**
- **LICENSE** (deviation): grant excludes affiliates/contractors and successors, and terminates without cure. **ASSIGN** (deviation): no M&A carve-out, unqualified consent. **T4C** (deviation): exit exists but indeterminate notice and no refund. **EXCLUSIVITY** (deviation): 3(i) requires every credit report from TrueLink with no performance exit. **NONCOMPETE** (needs review): none in this document, but the referenced "Non-Competition Agreement" must be reviewed. **LD** (compliant).

**Medium/low**
- **RENEWAL**, **MINCOMMIT**, **WARRANTY**, **TRANSITION**, **INSURANCE**: redlined as above. **MFN**, **NOSOLICIT**, **AUDIT**, **GOVLAW** (California law/courts within fallback): compliant, no redline.
